headline: Down to the silhouette and the phone
note: Wheels, paint tiles and the checkout commit button are fixed and the end-to-end test still passes 17/17. What is left is the car's front overhang — measured at 1.76 wheel diameters where a premium EV reads at 1.0–1.25 — and a configurator that gives a phone only a third of its viewport to configure in.
constraint: tesla.com cannot be reached from this build sandbox: Tesla's edge (Akamai) blocks the datacenter IP for direct requests and for every public screenshot service tried, web.archive.org is blocked by this environment's egress policy, and Chromium here has no outbound HTTPS at all. Live side-by-side capture of the real funnel is therefore impossible from inside this session. Critics score against docs/reference-spec.md — the Tesla funnel written down as measurable properties — plus their own knowledge of that funnel, and every round must still name the single largest remaining gap.

pieces.name: Hero
pieces.gap: The wheels turn a $50k sedan into clip art, and they sit at the exact centre of the 880px-wide car that occupies 61% of the section. Three physical faults, all in the same component: (1) The black sidewall band runs from r=0.688 to r=1.0 — 31% of the wheel rad

pieces.gap: The PAINT swatch row is broken text-on-text. At y~700-730 in the filter rail, the six paint names (Stellar White / Midnight Silver / Deep Blue / Obsidian Black / Ember Red / Glacier Quartz) render as unstyled ~14px inline text inside 40px cells, overflow in bo
